learning_outcomes.text: Students can describe the movements of systems with rigid bodies.
They know the kinematic quantities and their relationships and can apply them to solve problems from engineering practice.
Students are also able to analyze the movements of systems with rigid bodies under the action of forces and moments in the plane and to calculate the reaction forces resulting from the movement.
They know different methods and can use them purposefully in application.
They know the basic relationships of vibration theory, which they can reliably apply to oscillators with one degree of freedom.

syllabus_topics: Kinetics of Systems of Rigid Bodies
Work, Energy, Power, Impulse, Angular Momentum
